verses.fada-s-sururu-tabashiru-l-farahi-c1-v1: fāḍa s-surūru ʿalā shinqīṭa fārtāḥā waṭālaʿa s-saʿdu fī l-ʾāfāqi qad lāḥā
verses.fada-s-sururu-tabashiru-l-farahi-c1-v2: wal-bishru qad ghamara l-ʾarjāʾa wāmtalaʾat ʾayyāmu l-sbūʿi ʾaʿyādā waʾafrāḥā
verses.fada-s-sururu-tabashiru-l-farahi-c1-v3: wal-ʾarḍu tabsimu bit-tarḥībi hātifaha wal-misku wal-wardu min jannātihā fāḥā
verses.fada-s-sururu-tabashiru-l-farahi-c1-v4: tafattaqa z-zahru fī l-bustāni min faraḥi yuhdī r-rayāḥīna rummānā watuffāḥā
verses.fada-s-sururu-tabashiru-l-farahi-c1-v5: wāstaqbalat ʾarḍunā min sīnighāla fatā bal ghaytha rushdi mina l-ʿirfāni saḥḥāḥā
verses.fada-s-sururu-tabashiru-l-farahi-c1-v6: faḍīlatu sh-shaykhi wāfā fāstanāra bihi darbu ṭ-ṭarīqati taʿlīmā waʾīḍāḥā
verses.fada-s-sururu-tabashiru-l-farahi-c1-v7: muḥammadu l-muṣṭafā sī murshidu l-ʿulamā bil-bayyināti tafāsīrā washurrāḥā
verses.fada-s-sururu-tabashiru-l-farahi-c1-v8: yā marḥabā bika taʿlū min ḍamāʾirinā ʿammā nukinnu mina t-tabjīli ʾifṣāḥā
verses.fada-s-sururu-tabashiru-l-farahi-c1-v9: yā marḥabā bika wal-wafdi l-karīmi waman ghadā yaʾummu riḥāba "nwilki" ʾaw rāḥā
verses.fada-s-sururu-tabashiru-l-farahi-c1-v10: wabīljamāʿati min mustarshidīna wamin mustarshidāti bikum yabghūna ʾiṣlāḥā
verses.fada-s-sururu-tabashiru-l-farahi-c1-v11: khalīfatu l-wālidi sh-shaykhi t-tijāni salī li l-ḥājji mālika sī man madda l-rwāḥā
verses.fada-s-sururu-tabashiru-l-farahi-c1-v12: safīnatu l-ḥaqqi yabnī jāʿilā dusurā mina l-ḥadīthi wabīlqurʾāni ʾalwāḥā
verses.fada-s-sururu-tabashiru-l-farahi-c1-v13: waqādahā yanshuru l-ʾislāma fī ʾumami shattā fahhadhaba ʿubbādā waṣullāḥā
verses.fada-s-sururu-tabashiru-l-farahi-c1-v14: ʾinnā narā fīka shakhṣa sh-shaykhi wad-dikum ramza t-tawāṣuli waḍḍāʾa wawaḍḍāḥā
verses.fada-s-sururu-tabashiru-l-farahi-c1-v15: wajhu munīru waʾakhlāqu muʿattaqahu tasqī bihā sh-shahda war-rayḥāna war-rāḥā
verses.fada-s-sururu-tabashiru-l-farahi-c1-v16: fāhtazza ʾarwāḥunā wāzzayyanat warabat waʾanbatat fakasat bin-nūri ʾashbāḥā
verses.fada-s-sururu-tabashiru-l-farahi-c1-v17: jāshat ʿawāṭifunā madḥā waḥuqqa lanā ʾan naqriḍa sh-shiʿra tarḥībā waʾamdāḥā
verses.fada-s-sururu-tabashiru-l-farahi-c1-v18: yā ʾayyuhā sh-shaykhu hadhā "nwilki" muḥtafilā yuhdī lakum fataqabbal minhu miftāḥā
verses.fada-s-sururu-tabashiru-l-farahi-c1-v19: ʾahlā wasahlā bikum ʾinna l-maqāma hunā fī ʾahlikum ṭāba ʾimsāʾa waʾiṣbāḥā
verses.fada-s-sururu-tabashiru-l-farahi-c1-v20: waʿumma dawḥatakum ḥifẓu waʿāfiyatu wadumtumu liḍiyāʾi d-dīni miṣbāḥā
verses.fada-s-sururu-tabashiru-l-farahi-c1-v21: ʿalā l-ḥabībi ṣalātu llāhi tuqraʾu mā ghannā ʿalā ghuṣnihi l-qumriyyū ʾaw nāḥā
